page.overview:
Who is Urbano Montag?

Urbano Montag was a banker emploted by the Spacing Guild.

Urbano Montag was approached by the Prisoner at the CHOAM Exchange in Arrakeen. He aided them in depositing and withdrawing Solaris to and from their account.
